risks.title: Reduction in Medicare/Medicaid Reimbursements
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K, repeated mention with legislative examples (Budget Control Act), strong language ('material adverse effect'), highly critical category for an economic model dependent on public payments.

risks.title: Non-renewal or Dispute over the Master Lease
risks.score_rationale: Recent event (July-September 2025), mention of default and termination risk, existential impact ('loss of facilities'), alarming language ('Event of Default', 'termination'), high weight in the text.

risks.title: Transition to Value-Based Payment Models
risks.score_rationale: Detailed discussion with multiple programs (PDPM, HHVBP, ACO), direct link to revenues, concerned language ('unclear', 'difficult to predict'), strong regulatory trend through 2030.

risks.title: Shortage of Qualified Healthcare Staff
risks.score_rationale: Frequent mention, linked to rising costs and potential penalties, direct operational impact, reinforced by increasing CMS staffing requirements.

risks.title: Federal Staffing Standards in SNFs
risks.score_rationale: Recent rule (April 2024), although suspended until 2034, it remains a major regulatory threat with significant operational and financial implications if reinstated.

risks.title: Disaster and Climate Change Risks
risks.score_rationale: Forward-looking and uncertain language ('may', 'could'), but mention of direct physical threats to facilities and business continuity, with reference to climate.

risks.title: Dependence on Executive Leadership
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of reliance on executives, but no signs of imminent departure or internal tensions, measured language ('could have a material adverse effect').

ai_positioning.summary: No information available on NHC's artificial intelligence positioning in the 10-K
